data.name: reportParamsGroup.ToolTip
data.value: Those parameters are part of the announce string that RM will send to the tracker. Usually RM will generate those parameters automatically,but you have an option to enter them manually or use Memory Reader tool to get the params from your client.

data.name: fileSize.ToolTip
data.value: Finished % You can enter how much of the torrent you have already downloaded 100% = Seeding 0% = Leeching from the beginning RM remembers Finished % as well as all other options for each torrent.
